title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows — Episode2 I Want To, But I Can't

meta.Episode: Episode2 — I Want To, But I Can't
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still not ready to go home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
How are you physically?
I'll bring anything over that you need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's okay. I have everything I need... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, if you don't mind looking after Mafuyu for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'll come visit again next week, so let me know if anything changes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here you are, Mafuyu.
I made you some tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's umm... Bergamot.
According to Ms. Mochizuki, it's supposed to help calm your nerves.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I do feel a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's alright, I don't mind. There's no need for you to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll get back to work now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm going to go visit my dad.
I'll be back in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If the melody here goes like this, then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Stumbling over the string that's tangled around your foot...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I think that's him...
Right on time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll step in to help if anything happens...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
My name is Kanade Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'm Mafuyu Asahina's father.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for looking after her these past few days. I really appreciate what you've done for her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I apologize for not coming by sooner. Unfortunately, I was away on a business trip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...!
Thank goodness. I was so worried.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I feel so much better now that I've seen your face.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, your mother told me everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I can't condone what she did...
To think that she'd try to take your phone away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: However, I'm sure she had your best interests in mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
We can discuss this further when we get home.
I'm sure we'll be able to figure something out after we sit down and talk it all out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to go home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Your mother is feeling much better now.
I've already had a chance to speak with her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really can't go back right now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know I need to talk to Mom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't go back to that place...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's okay, Mafuyu.
Just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't know what exactly happened, but it's clear that you need some time and space...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As her parent, I feel ashamed for not realizing how much pain my own daughter was in until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I know this is asking a lot of you, but would you mind if Mafuyu stayed here for a little while?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not at all. She's more than welcome...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
I'll have Mafuyu's things and other daily necessities sent over soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'll come visit again.
When you feel ready, would you mind telling me what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And for as long as I keep staying at Kanade's house...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also have school and my exams to think about...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, please.
I was wrong, so... Let's go home and talk about this together.
